title: A rare ivory Oboe by JOAN PANORMO in Naples, circa 1770. Stamped PANORMO on all joints. Three corps de recharge, the finials of onion and cotton reel shape. The two silver gilt keys with octagonal flaps, one key with fish tail touch. Overall length with each top joint 22⅜in. (568mm.), 22½in. (572mm.), 22¹⁵/₁₆in. (578mm.) (4).  Langwill Dictionary of Wind Instrument Makers refers to string instrument makers of the PANORMO Family in London early 19th Century, it is doubtful if JOAN PANORMO was part of that family. (See Illustrations, Front Cover and Plate I)
